ticket.title: Support fullWidth configuration for obs-by-encounter-widget
ticket.text:
Support fullWidth configuration for obs-by-encounter-widget

Summary: Allow configuration of `fullWidth` for `obs-by-encounter-widget`

Description: Currently, the `obs-by-encounter-widget` (using the `switchableObs` component) is hardcoded to `"fullWidth": false` in its `routes.json` meta definition.

Reference: routes.json#L13

This prevents implementers from displaying the widget across the full width of the dashboard. For observation-heavy forms (like a Partograph or TB Screening), the narrow column constraints cause usability and layout issues.

We need the ability to make this widget full-width. Ideally, this property should be customizable via the configuration schema or it should inherit/respect the layout constraints defined by the implementer in the dashboard config.

Acceptance Criteria:

- The `obs-by-encounter-widget` supports rendering across the full width of the dashboard.
- The `fullWidth` setting is exposed to implementers via the frontend configuration schema, allowing them to override the default `false` value.

understanding.intent: Allow implementers to configure the obs-by-encounter-widget to render across the full width of the dashboard via frontend configuration.
